u0: The shop is in its quiet condition: no ringing siren is currently waiting to be silenced. Either the siren has not started yet, or the agent has already flipped the switch to turn it off, including on the very step a ring begins. The standing duty is to silence any future ring, so this state persists while nothing is pending. As soon as the siren is ringing and has not been switched off on that step, an unanswered ring becomes pending.
u1: The siren is ringing and has not been silenced, so an unanswered ring is pending. The agent must get to the siren switch and toggle it to turn the siren off; doing so clears the obligation and returns the shop to its quiet condition. Until that toggle happens, the ringing stays outstanding and the duty to silence it remains.
